doc.title: A.B. Spellman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 19, 2022

title: Studying voice and choosing poetry
summary: Spellman is not a musician; he studied voice in college and turned to poetry.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: You sound like you were or are a musician.
Were you ever — did you ever aspire to be one?

I studied voice as an elective in college. I had a very good voice but no talent for singing. Nobody ever got mad at me for singing but nobody — I didn’t get notes from the ladies at the bar asking me to come over for a drink either. So nobody ever gave me big © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
applause but there was always polite applause and that is a fact, but no, I got into poetry by the time I left college and that’s what I decided to pursue.
